```solidity
module TestBehavior_SECC_SDP {
    import from ComponentsAndPorts all;
    import from Timer_15118_2 all;
    import from Templates_CMN_SDP all;
    import from DataStructure_SDP all;
    import from TestBehavior_SECC/CommonBehavior all;
    import from Services_HAL_61851 all;
function f_SECC_CMN_TB_VTB_SDP_001(in Security_TYPE v_security,
            in verdicttype v_vct)
            runs on SECCTester
            return verdicttype {
    var integer v_count := 0;
    var SDP_Message v_responseMessage;
    while(v_count < vc_maxRepetitionSDP) {
        tcEVCC_SDP_Timer.start(par_EVCC_SDP_Timeout);
        pt_V2G_UTD_SDP_Port.send(md_CMN_SDP_Request_TYPE_001(v_security,'00'H)) to ccMULTicast;
        v_count := v_count + 1;
    }
    alt {
        [ ] pt_V2G_UTD_SDP_Port.receive(md_CMN_SDP_Response_TYPE_001(?
            ?, (49152 .. 65535), v_security, '00'H))
            -> value v_responseMessage {
                tcEVCC_SDP_Timer.stop;
                vc_V2G_Port_IPAddress := v_responseMessage(content.sdp_Response.secc_IPaddress;
                vc_V2G_Port_PortNumber := v_responseMessage(content.sdp_Response.secc_Port;
                vc_Security := v_responseMessage(content.sdp_Response.security;
                v_count := vc_maxRepetitionSDP;
                setverdict(pass,"SDP Response message was correct.));
        }
    [ ] pt_V2G_UTD_SDP_Port.receive(md_CMN_SDP_Response_TYPE_001(?
            ?, (49152 .. 65535), ?, '00'H))
            -> value v_responseMessage {
                tcEVCC_SDP_Timer.stop;
                v_count := vc_maxRepetitionSDP;
                setverdict(inconc,"SUT did not support the requested transmission security.")); 
    [ ] pt_V2G_UTD_SDP_Port.receive {
        repeat;
    }
    [ ] tcEVCC_SDP_Timer.timeout {
        // send a new SDP request message if v_count < vc_maxRepetitionSDP
        if(v_count == vc_maxRepetitionSDP) {
            setverdict(v_vct,"SDP repetition maximum is reached. SDP process " & "shall be stopped. "); 
        }
    }
    [ ] a_SECC_CommunicationSetup_Timeout(v_vct);
    }
    return getverdict;
} function f_SECC_CMN_TB_VTB_SDP_002(in Security_TYPE v_security) runs on SECCTester
        return verdicttype {
            alt {
                [ ] tc_V2G_SECC_CommunicationSetup_Timer.speed;
            }
```

```txt
function f_checkSupported_ISO_Namespace(in SupportedAppProtocolReq v-supportedAppProtocolReq, in verdicttype v_vct)
    runs on EVCCTester {
        for (var integer i:=0; i<lengthof(v-supportedAppProtocolReq.appProtocol_list); i:=i+1) {
            if (v-supportedAppProtocolReq.appProtocol_list[i].protocolNamespace == vcSupported_ISO_Nospace) {
                vc_SchemaID := v-supportedAppProtocolReq.appProtocol_list[i].schemaID;
                log("The requested schema is supported by the SECC.")
            }
        }
    } 
setverdict(v_vct, "The requested schema is not supported by the SECC.");
}
```

```lisp
function f_checkChosenPaymentService(Selected服务体系Type v_selected服务体系)
{
for (var integer i:=0; i.sizeof(v_selected服务体系); i:=i + 1) {
if (v_selected服务体系selectedService_list[i].serviceID == 2) {
if (v_selected服务体系selectedService_list[i].parameterSetID < 1 or v_selected服务体系selectedService_list[i].parameterSetID > 2) {
set verdict(fail, "Invalid parameterSetID was chosen.")
}
break;
}
else if (v_selected服务体系selectedService_list[i].serviceID == 3) {
if (v_selected服务体系selectedService_list[i].parameterSetID < 1 or v_selected服务体系selectedService_list[i].parameterSetID > 4) {
set verdict(fail, "Invalid parameterSetID was chosen.")
}
}
}
```

```solidity
function fEVCC_CMN_TB_VTB_Authorization_001(in verdicttype v_vct)
    runs on EVCCTester
    return verdicttype {
        var charstring v_message;
        var V2G_Message v_requestMessage;
        var boolean isSignatureOk := true;
        tc_V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timer.start(par_V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timeout);
        if (PICS_CMN_CMN_IdentificationMode == pnC) {
            vc_GenChallenge := fx_generateGenChallenge();
            pt_V2G_TAC_TLS_ALM_EVCC_Port.send(ctd_CMN_V2G_Message_001(
                md_CMN_MessageType_001(vc-sessionID),
                md_CMN BodiesType_001(ctd_EVCC_CMN_PaymentDetailsRes_001(oK,vc_GenChallenge,12345678))))};
    } else {
        set verdict(inconc, "Authorization: Check PICS_CMN_IdentificationMode");
    }
alt{
    [ ] pt_V2G_TAC_TLS_ALM_EVCC_Port.receive(ctd_CMN_V2G_Message_001(
            md_CMN_MessageType_002(vc-sessionID),
            md_CMN BodiesType_001(ctd_CMN_CMN_AuthorizationReq_002(?,vc_GenChallenge)))
        ] -> value v_requestMessage {
            tc_V2G_SECC_Sequence_Timer.stop;
            var Signature authSignature := v_requestMessage.headsignature__;
            var BodyType authorizationReqBodyType := v_requestMessage.body;
        }
        isSignatureOk := f.VerifySignature(authorizationReqBodyType,
                                authSignature,
                                vc_contractSignatureCertChain.
                                x509Certificate, v_vct);
    if (isSignatureOk) {
        return true;
    }
}
```

module Templates_CMN_V2GTcpTlsPortControl{ import from DataStructure_V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control language "XSD" all; import from urniso_15118_2_2013_DataTypes language "XSD" all; import from urniso_15118_2_2013_X509Def language "XSD" all; template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control/Internal_MessageReq md_CMN_CMN.tcpTlsStatusReq_001( template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control_Control_TYPE p_command) := { command := p_command } ; template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control/Internal_MessageRes md_CMN_CMN.tcpTlsStatusRes_001( template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control_Control_TYPE p_command, template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control_Ack_TYPE p_ACK, template boolean p_status) := { command := p_command, ack := p_ACK, result := { portStatus := {p_status} } } ; template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control/Internal_MessageRes md_CMN_CMN.tcpTlsStatusRes_002( template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control_Control_TYPE p_command, template V2G.tcp_TLS_Port_Control_Ack_TYPE p_ACK, template integer p_portNumber) := { command := p_command, ack := p_ACK, result := { portNumber := {p_portNumber} } } ; template V2G.tcp_TLS ,(Template(present)hexstring p_seccIpaddress, template(present)integer p_seccPort, template hexstring p_security) := { seccIpaddress: $=$ p_seccIpaddress, seccPort: $=$ p_seccPort, security: $=$ p_security } ; template V2G.tcp_TLS ,(Template(present)hexstring p_seccIpaddress, template(present)integer p_seccPort, template hexstring p_security, template(present)charstring pcipherSuite, template charstring p-enabledProtocol, template CertificateChainType p_certChain) := { seccIpaddress: $=$ p_seccIpaddress, seccPort: $=$ p_seccPort, security: $=$ p_security, tlsParameter: $=$ { cipherSuite: $=$ pcipherSuite, enabledProtocol: $=$ p-enabledProtocol, result: $=$ { certificateChain: $=$ p_certChain } } } 

```autohotkey
template V2G_TCP_TLS_Parameter md_CMN_CMN_TlsParameter_002(
    template(present) hexstring p_seccIpaddress,
    template(present) integer p_seccPort,
    template hexstring p_security,
    template(present) charstring pcipherSuite,
    template charstring p_enabledProtocol,
    template X509CertificateType p_certificate) := {
        seccIpaddress := p_seccIpaddress,
        seccPort := p_seccPort,
        security := p_security,
        TLSParameter := {
            cipherSuite := pcipherSuite,
            enabledProtocol := p_enabledProtocol,
            result := {
                certificate := p_certificate
            }
        }
    };
}with {
encode "DIN_V2G";
}
```
